name: manual_fdfdc3
claim: Mac Ollama answers a LAN probe of port 11434 only when OLLAMA_HOST binds beyond loopback. The portal on HTTPS 8443 is a separate listener and can pass while Ollama on the LAN address is refused.

decisions.notes: The Windows probe passed the portal and failed Ollama until the server listened on all interfaces. Loopback had already answered.

rationale: The Windows probe passed the portal and failed Ollama until the server listened on all interfaces. Loopback had already answered.
